oracle.statement: after both indexes (cat keyword, score integer) are deleted with 200 and their describe result.payload_schema entries are gone, filters on the de-indexed fields return exactly the seeded truth sets: must match cat=A -> ids {1,3,5} count 3; must range score>25 -> ids {2,4,5} count 3; combined must [cat=A, score>15] -> ids {3,5} count 2; no-filter control count 5; whole-table hit, empty set, wrong subset, or count/filter disagreement = Type4 (data-untouched promise violated through the filter face); pre-delete calibration mismatch = SCRIPT_ERROR (setup fault, never a defect); 5xx with healthy /healthz = Type3 (G8)
